clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for asbestos-cement pipes and fittings suitable for use with gravity flow at atmosopheric pressure, intended for sewerage  and drainage application.

clauses.title: General Appearance and Finish
clauses.text: 2. General Appearance and Finish— The pipes shall be seamless, compact and homogeneous. Their internal surface shall be regular and smooth. the internal face between the branch and the parent pipe of junctions shall have a flush and fair  finish.

clauses.title: Classification
clauses.text: 3. Classification— Classified according  to crushing strength as given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Fittings
clauses.text: 4. Fittings

clauses.title: General appearance and finish
clauses.text: 4.1 General appearance and finish shall comply with the requirements of 2.

clauses.title: Classification and Types
clauses.text: 4.2 Classification and Types

clauses.title: Shall be of equivalent strength to that of the adja
clauses.text: 4.2.1 Shall be of equivalent strength to that of the adjacent pipes.

clauses.title: The nominal diameter of
clauses.text: 4.2.2 The nominal diameter of fittings shall correspond to nominal diameters of pipes.

clauses.title: Thickness of the barrel
clauses.text: 4.2.3 Thickness of the barrel of the fittings shall be at least equal to that for corresponding pipe.

clauses.title: The basic types of fittings are
clauses.text: 4.2.4 The basic types of fittings are— bends, angle junctions, equal or unequal tees, double sockets, sleeves and saddles.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 5. Tolerances

clauses.title: Pipes
clauses.text: 5.1 Pipes — See Table 2. SUMMARY OF IS  6908 : 1991 ASBESTOS CEMENT PIPES AND FITTINGS FOR SEWERAGE AND DRAINAGE (First revision)

clauses.title: Fittings
clauses.text: 5.2 Fittings — Tolerances on the nominal thickness of the fittings shall be as follows: Upper deviation :  Free Lower deviation :—1.5 mm

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 6. Tests

clauses.title: Hydraulic ressure Test
clauses.text: 6.1 Hydraulic ressure Test— The pipe and joints when tested to a pressure of 0.25 MPa shall not show any fissure, leakage, or sweating on their outside surface.

clauses.title: Transverse Crushing Test
clauses.text: 6.2 Transverse Crushing Test— a) Pipes— Minimum 33 N/mm. b) Fittings — No minimum transverse crushing load is required

clauses.title: Longitudinal Bending Strength (Optional
clauses.text: 6.3 Longitudinal Bending Strength (Optional ) Shall not fracture below the following bending loads 100 mm 2.8 kN 125 mm 4.2 kN 150 mm 6.0 kN

clauses.title: Acid Resistance Test (Optional)
clauses.text: 6.4 Acid Resistance Test (Optional)  — The amount of acetic acid neutralied shall not exceed 0.100 g/cm

clauses.title: Joints
clauses.text: 7. Joints a) Asbestos cement couplings with rubber sealing rings. b) Cast  iron detachable joints with rubber sealing rings and bolts and nuts.
